summary: Iter112 — Aarohmm mobile app (Supabase-auth) adversarial testing. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter112_mobile_app.py (32 tests, all PASS) covering pre-login GSTIN broker (masked-email leak check), auth guard, PostgREST RLS isolation (own retailer only, filter-by-other returns [], anon reads blocked), server-priced orders + client-tamper resistance + client_ref idempotency, KYC gate (403 with restore), grievance path-traversal reject, Supabase Storage RLS (own folder allowed / other folder denied), contact-admin persistence, sync idempotency, app_fy() SQL function boundary check (Feb→2025-26, Apr→2026-27), and web-portal + FSM regressions. Also re-ran test_iter108_security_audit + test_iter110_waitlist — 32 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed. Frontend web-preview partial-verify: login screen renders, testids present, 'n/15 characters' counter works. TWO web-preview issues surfaced (below).

ui_bugs.issue: login-send-code-btn is NOT actually disabled at 0 or 14 chars in the web export — Playwright is_disabled() returns False and clicking with an empty GSTIN triggers a network request that resolves to 'Not Found' rather than being blocked client-side. The source code has `disabled={!gstinReady || busy}` on the Pressable, but on React-Native-Web that prop is not forwarded to the underlying interactive element. Style/opacity may or may not reflect the state; the button is still tappable. The 'n/15 characters' counter itself works.

integration_issues.issue: The exported web build was built with `apiBaseUrl=https://aarohmm-expo.preview.emergentagent.com` (from /app/mobile/app.json), and the review note says that host is currently serving a platform interstitial and returns 404 for every /api path. Result: entering the QA GSTIN and tapping 'Email me a code' surfaces 'Not Found' inside the login card — the app cannot reach the backend at all. Consequence: the signed-in shell (Stock / Order Pad / Orders / More screens with data-testids `stock-screen`, `pad-screen`, `orders-screen`, `more-screen`, etc.) is UNVERIFIED via the web preview in this environment. Injecting a Supabase localStorage session was not attempted because subsequent API calls (`/api/app/v2/me`, order calc/place, etc.) would still fail against that URL. Backend endpoints themselves are fully verified via pytest against localhost:8001.

verifications.no_raw_email_leak: Neither /gstin-lookup nor /auth/request-code echoes qa.aarohmm-test@centraders.com — masked_email uses first-2 + stars only. Verified in test_request_code_masked_only.
verifications.unknown_gstin_response: 404 with generic 'No active Aarohmm retailer' — does not confirm whether GSTIN is registered.
verifications.auth_guard: GET /api/app/v2/me → 401 (no header) / 401 (malformed bearer) / 200 with retailer_id RTL_APP_QA, gstin 29AAAAA0000A1Z5, kyc_complete true (valid Supabase access token from refresh_token flow).
verifications.rls_isolation: PostgREST direct reads under QA token: app_retailers → exactly 1 row (RTL_APP_QA); app_orders → only own rows; filter ?retailer_id=eq.RTL_TEST_B2B → []; app_grievances → only own; app_products → shared catalogue accessible; anon reads → [] or 401.
verifications.server_priced_order: Sent bogus price_per_box=1, grand_total=1, subtotal=1, total_amount=1 with 1 box of bold-bakhoor-b2b — server returned own computed grand_total (≈₹530+) matching /orders/calculate output; tamper fields ignored.
verifications.idempotency: Reposting same client_ref returned the same order_id (verified).
verifications.kyc_gate: Flipped documents_complete=false → POST /orders → 403 'Your KYC is still pending' → restored to true (verified).
verifications.storage_rls: PUT to grievance-uploads/RTL_TEST_B2B/evil.jpg → denied; PUT to grievance-uploads/RTL_APP_QA/<uuid>.jpg → 200/201.
verifications.contact_admin: POST /support/contact returns id + delivered flag; row written to retailer_messages with channel='mobile_app'.
verifications.regressions: GET /api/products, /api/blog/posts, /api/app/config → 200; POST /api/retailer-auth/login (07AAAAA0000A1Z5/Test@12345) → 200 with token; GET /api/external/v1/ping with FSM X-API-Key → 200.
verifications.web_preview_login_screen: http://localhost:3000/app-preview/index.html renders — Aarohmm brand visible, [data-testid="login-gstin-input"] and [data-testid="login-send-code-btn"] present, counter shows 'n/15 characters', no horizontal overflow, no 'navigate before mounting the Root Layout' console error, body innerText populated (no blank white screen).

action_items: Rebuild the web export (`npx expo export --platform web ...`) with `apiBaseUrl` pointing at a reachable backend (either http://localhost:8001 for local preview or the Render production URL). Currently /app/mobile/app.json sets it to https://aarohmm-expo.preview.emergentagent.com which returns 404 for every /api path in this environment, breaking the login flow inside the web preview and hiding the signed-in Stock/Pad/Orders/More screens from any automated UI verification. Remember to `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` after copying the new export into /app/frontend-next/public/app-preview/.

Fix `login-send-code-btn` disabled state on the web build. Source has `disabled={!gstinReady || busy}` but the underlying Pressable on react-native-web still fires onPress at 0 and 14 chars. Either wrap in a real <button disabled> or short-circuit onPress with `if (!gstinReady) return;`. This is defence-in-depth against the accidental request that currently surfaces the raw 'Not Found' string in the login card.

After rebuilding with a reachable API URL, re-run signed-in UI verification (Stock tab stock pills + search + plus button → Order Pad badge → Pad summary + Place order → Orders FY filter chips → More profile card).
Custom SMTP for Supabase (noted in MOBILE_APP_NOTES.md open items) — still pending user action; not tested here.
critical_code_review_comments: mobile_app_v2.py imports `requests as _requests` and pushes each call through `asyncio.to_thread` — fine for now but a native async HTTP client (httpx.AsyncClient) would remove the thread hop and share connection pool.

In verify_login_code, if the Supabase user exists but IS NOT an active retailer, `_retailer_by_gstin` runs BEFORE the Supabase verify call — a caller with a valid code but whose GSTIN was later deactivated would receive 404 on verify. Consider moving the active-retailer check after verify to keep the error taxonomy consistent with /me (which returns 403 in the same class of case).
app_login_codes ts is a raw epoch float; a TTL index on datetime + gstin would let the throttle self-clean and avoid unbounded growth.
login.tsx line 136: `disabled={!gstinReady || busy}` — on react-native-web Pressable this does NOT prevent onPress. Add an early return guard inside sendCode() to be safe (see action items).
70 pre-existing DeprecationWarnings (Pydantic V1 @validator, FastAPI @app.on_event) still emitted per test run — flagged again from iter111, no new ones introduced by mobile_app_v2.
app.json's `apiBaseUrl` currently hard-coded to the preview URL; consider driving from EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL only, so a fresh export defaults correctly per environment.

Only remaining gap is that the WEB PREVIEW at localhost:3000/app-preview points at an unreachable emergent-preview host (baked into the exported bundle), so the signed-in Expo screens are UNVERIFIED. After main agent rebuilds the export with the correct apiBaseUrl and restarts frontend, re-run the signed-in shell UI verification. rca_of_the_issue: 1) `Not Found` in login card = fetch to https://aarohmm-expo.preview.emergentagent.com/api/app/v2/auth/request-code → the emergent preview URL currently returns 404 for /api and the app surfaces the HTTPException detail verbatim. Root cause: app.json extras.apiBaseUrl baked into the exported web bundle at build time (not read at runtime). 2) Button-not-really-disabled = react-native-web Pressable `disabled` prop is style-only, does not block onPress; source code lacks an early return in the handler.
